layout:
Extract every LoG2 enemy class (class table 0x086d56ac, 109 rows x 24 bytes) + spawns, AI summary, drops,
names and graphics references -> data/log2/enemies.json.

Class row layout (VERIFIED: enemy init 0x0800e280/0x0800f7cc, takeHit 0x0800e485, exp award 0x0800e4d2,
scouter page 0x0801790e):
  +0x00 u32 exp           base exp reward (see exp_award)
  +0x04 u32 hp            max HP (copied to entity+0x188 at spawn)
  +0x08 u32 ai_state      initial AI state (index into state table 0x086d5194; see ai.json)
  +0x0c u8  STR           attacker stat for melee attacks (damage formula 0x0800f910)
  +0x0d u8  POW           attacker stat for energy attacks
  +0x0e u8  END           defence: incoming damage *= (128-END)/128
  +0x0f u8  melee_mult    incoming melee damage *= melee_mult/128
  +0x10 u8  energy_mult   incoming energy damage *= energy_mult/128
  +0x11 3 bytes padding
  +0x14 u32 death_node    node whose fn2 runs on death (0x086d2b6c explode+exp, 0x086ff3c4 exp only, ...)
Entity bytes +0x160..+0x164 receive STR,POW,END,melee_mult,energy_mult (0x0800f7cc).
exp_award: award = class.exp; if class.exp>5: L=active char level (0x08004214); if L==50 -> no exp; span = expTable[L]-expTable[L-1]; award = clamp(class.exp, span>>7, span>>1). Queued as world event (vtable 0x080245b0) and added by 0x08003d58. VERIFIED (snake exp 13 at Lv40 gave 4747 = 607735>>7).
spawn_condition_semantics: objdef+4 evaluated by 0x08003f06 at map load (0x0800c526): 0 = always; small non-zero (e.g. 1) = never at load (spawned/activated by event scripts: bosses); hi16=1 flag set, hi16=2 flag clear, hi16=3 test-and-clear (flag index = lo16 into the story-flag bitfield), larger = script ptr evaluated by the VM.
enemy_attack_note: Enemies use attack table 0x086db2cc ids 1 (energy 1024), 2 (melee 1024), 3 (energy 1024); damage to the player uses the shared formula 0x0800f910 with S = enemy STR (melee) or POW (energy) and the player END/multipliers.

scouter_entries.name: Gohan
scouter_entries.description: Gohan is the son of martial artist Goku.  Like his father, Gohan is a powerful martial artist, despite his young age.  Analysis of scouter data indicates untapped potential not yet revealed.

scouter_entries.name: Goku
scouter_entries.description: Goku, despite his human appearance is actually an alien of the Saiyan race.  Many Saiyans are considered highly dangerous.  In fact, two of these aliens destroyed East City several years ago.  However, Goku has made no known threatening moves towards the Earth.  Little about Goku is known - however he is a powerful martial artist who once won the World Tournament.  Goku trained under Master Roshi.

scouter_entries.name: Hercule
scouter_entries.description: This wrestler claims to be the world champion of martial arts, but no data can be found as to which championship he has won.  Despite this oversight, Hercule holds the world records for many feats of strength, such as pulling buses and breaking piles of bricks with a karate chop.  Hercule is one of the world's most popular celebrities.

scouter_entries.name: Piccolo
scouter_entries.description: Piccolo is a powerful martial artist who once participated in the World Tournament.  Piccolo is an alien of the Namek race.  Scanning of the Namek cellular structure reveals that they are very similar to plants.  Not much is known about them.  Antennas on their heads are believed to be used for telepathic powers; however, they could simply be decorative.  Nameks have very large ears giving them an acute sense of hearing.

scouter_entries.name: Trunks
scouter_entries.description: There is no data on this person.  Cellular analysis indicates that Trunks has Saiyan and human DNA.  Power level analysis indicates that Trunks is one of the most powerful fighters on the planet at this time.

scouter_entries.name: Vegeta
scouter_entries.description: This powerful Saiyan warrior is said to be responsible for the destruction of East City.  There are not many people on Earth who could stop him.  This being said, Vegeta has not made any aggressive moves towards the planet since he battled Goku.  Reports indicate that Goku and Vegeta are now allied, and Vegeta has been seen at the Capsule Corporation.  Reasons are unknown.
